## Packages

```{r}
# Install pacman once (if missing) and load it
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

# Install (if missing) and load the packages for this lecture
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, #this is for data science
            janitor, #this is to clean data 
            palmerpenguins, # this is dataset
            gtsummary, #this is for tables
            here) #this is for file paths
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
library(readxl) # this is to read Excel files
dirty_data <- read_excel(here("Lecture_2", "data", "dirty_data.xlsx"), skip = 1) # skip = 1 skips the title row
View(dirty_data)
```

# Data cleaning

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
dirty_data |>
  get_dupes() # find duplicate rows (from janitor)
```

```{r}
# Remove empty rows and columns (where every value is NA)
dirty_data |>
  janitor::remove_empty(c("rows", "cols"))
```
